transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I can help answer questions you might have about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions for me today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora, yes, I do have some questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. However, you should avoid strenuous exercise for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information, that's helpful. I also wanted to know, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using them unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you for clarifying that. I'm also experiencing sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside. However, significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, is not normal and may need further assessment. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks, I'll definitely keep that in mind. One last thing, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for your vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. This should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or it's getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I appreciate all your help, Dora. I don't have any more questions for now. Thank you!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! Just to confirm, have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you again for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
